note: Laws in force on 1 January 2000. free_market: a liberal market economy, with healthcare provided separately by the tax-funded NHS (national_health_service). volunteer_force: no conscription; the armed forces are professional. official_religion: the Church of England is the established church in England, with freedom of worship for all. free_trade reflects EU single-market membership. regulated_internet is a judgement call for the period before the later surveillance legislation of the 2000s and 2010s.
